muc.title: Typing it again every day
muc.text: Last time, AI learned who you are. But every day you still retype the same long prompts.

muc.title: Great prompts get lost
muc.text: You once wrote a great prompt, and AI did exactly what you wanted. A few days later, it's buried in your chat history and you can't find it.

muc.title: Turn your prompt into a template
muc.text: Turn it into a template: keep the good part, and leave blanks for the parts that change. The 4-part formula from an earlier video makes a great template.

muc.title: A shelf of templates
muc.text: Make a few templates for the tasks you do most. When you need one, grab it, fill in the blanks, paste it in, and you're done.

muc.title: Shortcuts for speed
muc.text: Even faster: save templates as text shortcuts on your phone. Type a few characters, and the whole prompt appears.

muc.title: A "My prompts" page
muc.text: Open your notes app, create a page called "My prompts", and save the three prompts you use most, with blanks for the parts that change.

muc.title: Chats full of mixed tasks
muc.text: Your prompts are tidy now, but your chats are a mix of everything. Part three gives each task its own room.
